resources.string: On your computer, open MyFitnessPlan, go to Settings → Devices and turn sharing on. The TV then finds it here.
Looking for MyFitnessPlan on your network…
No computer found. Check that sharing is on and the TV is on the same Wi-Fi, or type the address below.
Or type the address from Settings → Devices:
For example 192.168.1.20 (spaces work instead of dots)
That doesn\'t look like an address. Try something like 192.168.1.20:7777.
Couldn\'t reach MyFitnessPlan at %1$s. Check that the computer is on, MyFitnessPlan is running with sharing on (Settings → Devices), and the TV is on the same Wi-Fi.
Something answered at %1$s, but it isn\'t MyFitnessPlan. Check the address.
MyFitnessPlan at %1$s isn\'t answering. Check that the computer is on and MyFitnessPlan is running with sharing on (Settings → Devices).
The MyFitnessPlan at %1$s is too old for the TV app. Update it on your computer, then choose Try again.
